title: 第005章 一拳轰杀第006章 万道帝体三重凝气
content_zh:
这声音，带着挑衅，更有深深的嘲讽。
“齐家明知道叶炎已成废物，如今还如此？”
“他们这是成心的！叶炎若迎战，那下场将会无比凄惨，若不出手……用不了一日整个苍云城便知晓叶炎连十三岁之人都不如，甚至更跪地交剑吧？”
无论如何，叶炎乃至叶家的尊严都将彻底扫地。
只是，叶炎的眼眸一凝。
既如此……他何惜一战？
“哼！”
但这时，一道冷声之声却是响彻此地。
“齐家好大的威风？”叶龙以及叶家的人顿时赶到。
望着叶龙等人，齐长剑神色一变。
叶家大长老都来了，今日一切事不可为，只能离开了。
只是齐水却不甘心就这般走，而是喝道：“叶炎，难道你这辈子只躲在叶家身后了吗？你一个男人只能如此，当真让人悲哀，哈哈哈……”
“你父亲当年如此，而你这般，我现在甚至有些怀疑……你父亲当年所为是真是假！”
哒！
叶炎本不想多事准备与叶家之人离开，但当齐水话语说完，叶炎的脚步也随之停下。
龙有逆鳞，触之必死！
父亲如山，叶炎最为敬重。
今日，齐水竟敢羞辱？
“你不是想要与我一战吗？今日……我便成全你！”叶炎开口。
什么？

当其话语落下，四周之人全都惊动。
即便是齐长剑神色也随之一变，叶炎答应了？
“炎儿，不可……”至于叶龙眼眸一缩，顿时道。
今日可不是意气用事之时，齐水虽只有十三岁，但实力不俗，至少叶炎绝不是其对手。
“呵呵，这么多人看着，而且叶炎亲口答应，叶家大长老……你是想说你叶家人说话不算话吗？”齐长剑顿时喝道，他嘴角处也流露出喜色。
叶炎直接道：“你们废话太多了些，出手吧……”
叶炎话语落下，四周众人一愣，旋即道：
“叶炎，真是愚蠢！”
“年少轻狂意气用事，这会害了自己！”
至于齐水阴冷一笑，体内劲力顿时爆发，轰鸣一声直接挥拳向着叶炎而去。
这一拳，带着呼啸劲风，这是丝毫不留情面要将叶炎彻底打垮。
望着这一幕，叶龙牙齿紧咬，担忧万分。
但却见叶炎神色淡然，在齐水拳头将要靠近叶炎之时，叶炎方才同样轰出一拳，这一拳……没有任何的花哨，朴实无华，但却蕴含着极大的力量。
叶炎，虽也是九重筑体境，但他帝体之下这等境界更是精深。
因此，两拳相撞之下，一道闷声响起，齐水的身躯便瞬间倒飞出去狠狠的落在了地面之上，口中更是吐出一道鲜血。
咻……
还没等众人惊讶，叶炎便来到了齐水的身前。
“叶炎，你……你要做什么？”齐水大惊，脸色都白了。
“辱我父，当死……”叶炎开口，随后一脚抬起，直接向着齐水面门而去。
“叶炎，尔敢？”齐长剑大喝一声，杀意凛然。
content_en:
This voice was provocative and deeply mocking.
"The Qi family clearly knows that Ye Yan has become a waste, but is he still like this now?"
"They did this intentionally! If Ye Yan fights, the end will be extremely miserable. If he doesn't take action... it won't take a day for the entire Cangyun City to know that Ye Yan is not as good as a thirteen-year-old man, and even kneels down to hand over a sword, right?"
No matter what, the dignity of Ye Yan and even the Ye family will be completely destroyed.
However, Ye Yan's eyes narrowed.
In that case...why would he bother to fight?
"Hmph!"
But at this time, a cold voice echoed throughout the place.
"How powerful is the Qi family?" Ye Long and the people from the Ye family rushed over immediately.
Looking at Ye Long and others, Qi Changjian's expression changed.
The eldest elders of the Ye family are here. Nothing can be done today and they can only leave.
But Qi Shui was not willing to leave like this, but shouted: "Ye Yan, are you just hiding behind the Ye family in this life? You can only do this as a man, it is really sad, hahaha..."
"Your father was like this back then, and you are like this. Now I even have some doubts...whether what your father did back then was true or false!"
Da!
Ye Yan didn't want to get into trouble and prepared to leave with the Ye family, but when Qi Shui finished speaking, Ye Yan also stopped.
The dragon has reverse scales, if you touch it you will die!
Ye Yan respects his father the most.
How dare Qi Shui humiliate him today?
"Don't you want to fight me? Today...I will help you!" Ye Yan said.
What?
When his words fell, everyone around him was shocked.
Even Qi Changjian's expression changed. Ye Yan agreed?
"Yan'er, you can't..." Ye Long narrowed his eyes and said immediately.
Today is not the time to be impulsive. Although Qi Shui is only thirteen years old, he is very powerful. At least Ye Yan is definitely not his opponent.
"Haha, so many people are watching, and Ye Yan personally agreed, the eldest elder of the Ye family... Do you want to say that your Ye family's words don't mean what you say?" Qi Changjian shouted immediately, with joy showing at the corners of his mouth.
Ye Yan said directly: "You guys are talking too much, take action..."
After Ye Yan finished speaking, everyone around him was stunned and immediately said:
"Ye Yan, how stupid!"
"Young people are frivolous and act on impulse, which will harm themselves!"
As for Qi Shui, who smiled coldly, the strength in his body suddenly exploded, and he punched Ye Yan directly with a roar.
This punch, with howling wind, was mercilessly intended to completely defeat Ye Yan.
Looking at this scene, Ye Long clenched his teeth and was extremely worried.
However, Ye Yan's expression was indifferent. Just when Qi Shui's fist was about to approach Ye Yan, Ye Yan just punched out as well. This punch... was not fancy at all, simple and unpretentious, but it contained great power.
Although Ye Yan is also in the ninth-level body-building realm, this realm under his imperial body is even more profound.
Therefore, when the two fists collided, a muffled sound sounded, and Qi Shui's body instantly flew backwards and landed hard on the ground, with a stream of blood spitting out of his mouth.
Phew...
Before anyone could be surprised, Ye Yan came to Qi Shui.
"Ye Yan, you...what are you going to do?" Qi Shui was shocked and turned pale.
"Insult my father and you will die..." Ye Yan said, then raised his foot and walked directly towards Qishuihui Gate.
"Ye Yan, how dare you?" Qi Changjian shouted, with killing intent.
